command: python -I ncd/run_aacil_compact.py --datasets NSL-KDD --methods aacil_ema_kd --seeds 1 2 3 4 42 --config ncd/configs/problem_scout_section21.json --output-dir ncd/results/problem_scout/section31/formal_local_v1/nsl_kdd/aacil_ema_kd --source-commit c97f83b1bfa14f4d2665ff33c45c897941e9ddb3 --device cuda --lambda-g 0.5 --der-alpha 1.0 --der-beta 1.0 --cbf-epochs 1 --cbf-lr-multiplier 0.1 --ema-decay 0.999 --ema-consistency 1.0
cost_scope: training=gate+family; family=base_family+CBF (nested, not additive again); EMA consistency forward/update included in base_family; buffer_selection includes CBF subset selection; WA and gate-teacher/entry-logit/calibration/evaluation separate; prototype cost is zero; excludes loading/serialization/failed attempts

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: UNSW/NSL validation seeds5/6: G lambda .25/.5; KD-weak alpha,beta .25/.5; other KD variants alpha=beta=1
effective_config.family_parameter_constraint: constant through all stages; train and inference <=2x full eventual original attack-head F
effective_config.future_output_policy: unseen attack outputs masked; all parameter rows reserved at initialization
effective_config.selection_aggregation: mean seeds5/6 final validation BAcc and signed old-class forgetting separately per dataset
effective_config.selection_validation_policy: fixed permanent stratified10percent attack TRAIN holdout plus permanent Normal TRAIN holdout; only seen classes; evaluation only; attack holdout outside M during selection only

limitations: One slow EMA F teacher inspired by Arani, Sarfraz and Zonooz, Learning Fast Learning Slow, ICLR2022 https://openreview.net/forum?id=uxxFrDwrE7Y. Their CLS-ER has two semantic memories; this uses exactly one EMA copy, fixed decay .999 and consistency MSE weight1 on old replay. Student CE learns all seen attacks; inference uses EMA only. This is a simplification, not replication.
Compact retention candidate; fixed attack validation outside M only during selection, never optimization or test-based tuning.
Two networks and refreshed benign data are not compute-matched to one-stage baselines.
Does not close RQ1/RQ3 or establish substantive novelty.

publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged.

selection_rule: UNSW and NSL seeds5/6 only: each dataset validation forgetting <= external-five minimum + .01; maximize cross-dataset mean final validation BAcc; simplicity within .01; implemented by development queue
